text: Building Digital Solutions That Drive Business Growth
GrowBig Technologies LLP delivers modern websites, mobile applications, cloud solutions, digital transformation, AI-powered software, branding, and technology consulting for startups and enterprises.
We build scalable digital products that transform how businesses connect with their customers.
Custom websites and software solutions designed to improve business operations, performance, and user experience.
High-performance Android and iOS mobile applications built with intuitive design and seamless functionality.
Powerful CRM and ERP systems that automate workflows, improve productivity, and streamline business management.
Grow your online presence with SEO, social media marketing, paid advertising, branding, and content strategies.
Professional customer support and business process outsourcing services that enhance customer satisfaction and efficiency.
Intelligent AI-powered solutions and workflow automation to reduce manual effort, improve accuracy, and boost productivity.
We proudly collaborate with trusted global partners to deliver innovative technology solutions and world-class services.
Building digital excellence for startups and enterprises across India and beyond.

text: We help businesses grow through innovative software development, AI solutions, digital marketing, and business process outsourcing—delivering reliable, scalable, and future-ready technology solutions.
The principles that guide every line of code, every design decision, and every client conversation.

Deliver scalable, reliable, and cost-effective digital solutions while building long-term client partnerships through innovation, quality, and customer-focused development. Our mission is to empower rural communities by reaching users who are still unable to access the opportunities of the digital world and helping them bridge the digital divide.

To become a globally trusted technology and outsourcing partner by delivering innovative digital solutions that empower businesses to grow and succeed. We envision a world where everyone has access to knowledge, creating equal opportunities for all and enabling inclusive digital growth.
Discover what makes us a trusted technology partner for businesses worldwide.
We manage every stage of your project, from planning and development to deployment and ongoing support.
Our delivery approach adapts to your business needs, ensuring seamless growth and efficient project execution.
We deliver high-quality technology solutions that maximize value while keeping costs optimized.
Our rigorous testing and quality processes ensure reliable, secure, and high-performing solutions.
Through our partnership with EOS Globe, we leverage global expertise and best practices to deliver enhanced business value.
The people steering strategy, technology, and culture at GrowBig.

Michael D'Souza is the CEO of GrowBig Technologies, holding a B.S.L., LL.B. degree with expertise in law, governance, and business management. He is a successful entrepreneur in the agriculture sector and serves as an elected Member of the Zilla Parishad. Committed to innovation, ethical leadership, and social responsibility, he actively contributes to community welfare and sustainable development.

Sushant Paste is the Director of GrowBig Technologies and holds a Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science. With over 20 years of experience in the IT industry, he specializes in software solutions, project management, and technology-driven innovation. He is committed to driving operational excellence, digital transformation, and sustainable business growth through reliable and innovative technology solutions..

Vinayak Jadhav is the Director of GrowBig Technologies, holding an M.Tech. and B.E. in Computer Science. With over 20 years of experience in the education and IT sectors, he has expertise in teaching, software development, and technical leadership. He is committed to driving innovation, technical excellence, and delivering high-quality technology solutions while fostering continuous learning and professional growth.

Manish Jadhav is the HR Admin at GrowBig Technologies, holding a B.E. in Information Technology, an MBA in Human Resource Management, an LL.B., and a Diploma in Cyber Law. With extensive experience across the banking, media, and IT industries, he specializes in HR management, operations, and organizational development. He is committed to building high-performing teams, fostering innovation, and driving sustainable organizational growth through people-centric leadership.

Heena Shaikh is the Recruitment Officer at GrowBig Technologies and holds a Bachelor of Arts (B.A.) and a Master of Arts (M.A.) in History. She is responsible for talent acquisition, candidate engagement, and supporting the company's hiring initiatives. With a strong focus on identifying the right talent and building a skilled workforce, she contributes to the organization's growth through effective recruitment and people-centric practices.
Want to join our growing team?
We are always looking for talented people who share our passion for great software.
Building digital excellence for startups and enterprises across India and beyond.
